item.title: CELEBRATING SHAN NATIONAL DAY: Bridging the Past and Future at 79
item.description: Once again it is the 79th Shan National Day and as usual we are reminded on how far we have come as a non-state nation, within the Union of Burma as a component, or rather how deep have we fallen from our original founding of Shan nation and protection of its sovereignty.
